أن: Indeed, if a person were to perform an obligatory act within it, it would be as if he had performed seventy obligatory acts at other times.
لاشتمالها: No addition is made to it.
الغرر: The element of uncertainty or risk (gharr)
لقد: He was generous and kind to people, treating them with kindness and courtesy until he died, may Allah have mercy on him.
لرواد: For those who seek knowledge or pursue a noble cause
ونحوهم: And those who are similar to them
ويسرها: And He made it easy for her.
والتدليس: And the act of deception or forgery.
يقتصه: He will take retribution for it.
منتهاه:: He has attained the highest level of learning.
منها: Some of them are questions about Allah Almighty, and Sheikh al-Islam Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Taymiyyah, may Allah have mercy on him, answered them.
تطلع: To look out or over; to appear above.
ويرعاكم: And He will provide for you
